caption: The drawing depicts an oval box with a hinged lid, both shown open to reveal the decoration on the interior and exterior surfaces. The box is illustrated in brown and beige tones with touches of light blue, and is adorned with detailed scenes. On both the lid and the body, there are groups of human figures dressed in period clothing and hats, seated or standing under stylized trees. Some figures are accompanied by animals, likely dogs and horses. The background consists of trees with leafy canopies rendered in brown, and the ground is indicated with brown shading and some sparse grass. The lower edge of the lid and the upper edge of the box body are bordered by a horizontal band highlighted in blue and embellished with a geometric pattern in yellow, blue, and white. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the landscape scene wrapping around the surfaces, creating a continuous narrative. The image is set against an off-white background.
title: Bandbox
